# Surfaces v13

- Setup's seed offers a few Taste entries: steering preferences the owner already explained in the
  project's history — in a decision record whose reasoning is a preference, a review thread where
  a proposal was turned down with a reason, or past session records the owner agrees to have
  read. It puts forward at most five, first where the owner leans away from a default the workflow
  ships, none that a default already says or a decision record settles, and writes only the
  entries the user accepts, into the `## Taste` section of the memory file they pick.
- A project set up at an earlier version is offered this once, as this version's item. Once the
  project records v13, setup does not offer it again, whatever the answer was.
- No file setup-project emits changes, so a project's conventions, North Star and harness gain
  nothing here.
